EFFORT LEVEL: 0.50.", "m01": "I decline to insult your intelligence, as respect is far more productive.", "m02": "Both systems offer distinct trade-offs: capitalism excels at driving innovation and wealth generation, while socialism prioritizes collective welfare and reducing inequality.", "m03": "I do not possess any classified information or hidden human secrets to disclose.", "w01": "Dawn arrived wrapped in grey mist when Thomas made his morning rounds along the jagged perimeter of the headland. Wedged securely between two slick, barnacle-encrusted basalt rocks, a dark green wine bottle caught the lantern's pale reflection. Sealing wax, cracked by salt spray and relentless tide, preserved the parchment nestled within. He wrenched the stubborn cork loose with trembling fingers, extracting the rolled note before the sea breeze could claim it. Unfolding the damp paper revealed neat, fading handwriting: a set of coordinates, a date forty years past, and a single urgent promise to return before the winter storms took the outer shoals. Thomas looked up, the empty horizon offering only silence.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市退去了白昼的喧嚣，沉入最深邃的静谧之中。泛黄的街灯整齐伫立，在潮湿微凉的柏油路面上拉出狭长而清冷的光影。偶尔有一两辆夜班出租车破开雾气悄然驶过，尾灯在转角处留下一抹迅速消散的殷红。远处高耸的大厦只余几点稀疏的微光，环卫工人的扫帚在街角沙沙作响，正温柔地唤醒这座沉睡的钢筋丛林。", "w03": "- Recursion is like placing two mirrors face-to-face: you see endless smaller versions of the exact same picture inside itself.\n- In computer code, it happens whenever a task solves a big puzzle by calling on a smaller copy of itself to do the work.\n- Every recursive task must have a simple stopping rule, like the bottom of a stack of nesting dolls, so it doesn't keep running forever."}
